title: Applying acceleration to Krylov subspace eigenvalue solvers
summary: In this paper, we apply acceleration to the inverse-free preconditioned Krylov subspace method introduced by Golub and Ye, which solves the symmetric generalized eigenvalue problem for the algebraically smallest eigenvalue. As the method is an improvement on steepest descent, we consider acceleration based on Nesterov accelerated steepest descent and Polyak's heavy-ball method. We extend acceleration to the block version of the Krylov subspace method and prove convergence for a more generalized choice of subspace.
